blurb: Guests rent electric boats to tour Annapolis waterways at a top speed of 5 MPH. The boats are silent, luxurious, and environmentally friendly. Suitable for celebrating special occasions or admiring waterfront homes and local sights.

quotes.author: Martha H.
quotes.text: We had 10 people for a wedding in Annapolis. We spent the morning puttering the waterways around the area. We were in and out of the surrounding coves. It was a great way to see the area from a different perspective. The owner was very informative and gave us perfect instructions.

quotes.author: Anthony P.
quotes.text: First, the owner Greg, is very kind, accommodating, and personable. The boat is very well maintained. Fortunately, the weather was ideal for our trip, and our family had a blast. I highly recommend this excursion when visiting downtown Annapolis! Thank you, Greg!

quotes.author: Torge D.
quotes.text: The service is fantastic, the boats are clean and well maintained. The whole family had a great time and it was a refreshing and relaxing outing. Highly recommended We will do this again in the near future.

quotes.author: Nonnie H.
quotes.text: We rented a boat for 2 hours on Father's Day. The owner was so helpful and friendly. It was such a great experience and we will definitely do it again. Thank you Annapolis Electric Boat Rentals!
